title: UI/collab: concurrent class editing can drop a remote peer's .as class
description: packages/authoring-ui/src/ClassesPanel.tsx. When a remote peer edits/creates a DIFFERENT class while the local user is typing, doc.asClasses identity changes but the re-hydrate effect early-returns because pendingEditRef.current is true (:214-232) — it adopts the incoming reference WITHOUT mirroring the remote class into the local OPFS VFS. Then the local debounced syncToDoc (:313-323) runs syncDocFromVfs(docRef.current, vfs), which reads the VFS (still missing the remote class) and produces a doc that OMITS the peer's class; that doc is pushed back through the binding, deleting the peer's class for everyone. Outside the task-1317 solo cases. Fix: in syncDocFromVfs/the debounced reconcile only update/add classes present in the VFS and never delete a doc class the VFS didn't originate unless it was a local VFS remove (track via vfsOpInFlightRef); or re-hydrate the remote class into the VFS before reconciling even when an edit is pending. Confidence: needs-repro (concurrent class edits in a live session).
